name: Histology Tissue Fold Dataset v1.0
notes: 2,127 real 10x H&E microscope fields from 283 source slides and five veterinary tissues; 1,228 fold-positive images with manual masks. Two released positive masks are empty and require an audited localization exclusion. Fold only: no crack class, human clinical WSI, COMET, or CosMx claim. Associated publication: https://doi.org/10.3390/bioengineering13080937.

name: GrandQC expert test patches
notes: Strong H&E external benchmark; no dedicated crack/tear class. Merck use requires Legal/licensor clearance.

name: QUALIFAI models and Lunaphore dataset
notes: Best public COMET-related fold-localization publication, but not an independently reproducible efficacy set. The exact 12.49 GB, publisher-sized, MD5-matching Zenodo v2 archive terminates unexpectedly during gzip decoding and exposes no masks/split manifest. Five complete real DAPI TIFFs were recovered for compatibility and label-free proxy testing only. Dataset is CC BY 4.0; repository code/model terms require separate review.

name: Official Lunaphore COMET lung TMA example
notes: Useful only for approved ingestion/performance testing. The download page terms restrict research-output, commercial, and external-sharing uses; no fold/crack reference masks are supplied.

name: HistoArtifacts
notes: Useful for patch classification only; not a pixel-localization benchmark.

name: Foucart artifact segmentation data
notes: Small and incompletely annotated; tear and fold are conflated.

name: CosMx gastric mucosa raw morphology images
notes: Two source slide/run archives. Four CRC-verified real FOVs are locally represented by the locked public-data manifest. Native morphology MPP is 0.18 from TIFF metadata. No fold/crack ground truth.

name: CosMx pediatric high-grade glioma raw data
notes: Two independent slide/run directories in an 8.31 GB archive. Two exact byte-range-extracted and CRC-verified real FOVs augment the proxy benchmark. Native MPP is 0.120280945 from TIFF metadata. No fold/crack ground truth.

name: Official CosMx public datasets
notes: Useful for parser and nominal-domain testing, not fold/crack efficacy evaluation.

name: Dryad CosMx melanoma morphology images
notes: CC0 real-input and nominal-domain resource containing four CosMx slides and morphology FOVs. It has no artifact labels, so it cannot support fold/crack efficacy without a new expert reference set.
